notes: height.bin (1024×1014) = area-average of the 1 m lidar over each cell footprint (rasterio average, mercator node grid; 100 % lidar, no fill needed). normal.png 4096×4058 (1.92 m/px) from the lidar resampled to 0.96 m (bilinear), central-difference normals ×EXAG 2.2, 2×2 box-averaged and renormalised. sat.jpg 8192×8116 (0.96 m/px) from 6 full-resolution NAIP quads (lanczos), each colour-mapped with the same per-quad transform as hawaii_flow plus a 700 m local residual field toward hawaii_flow, outer 192 px feathered into the new hawaii_flow imagery (edge-ring difference 0). No clouds in this area. Known limitation: NAIP frame seamlines inside quads leave a few faint tonal steps (e.g. inside the grey pāhoehoe east of centre). Imagery dates Jan–Apr 2022 = before the Nov 2022 Mauna Loa eruption; lidar 2018–2020. Old files kept as height_v1.bin / sat_v1.jpg. The renderer's uCloud cloud-removal pass is no longer needed for this region (NAIP is cloud-free here); bright grey pāhoehoe could be mistaken for cloud by it. Texture memory: sat 8192×8116 RGBA ≈ 266 MB (+mips) on the GPU; downscale to 6144 if renders run out of memory.
